files.description: Website sessions in June 2025 (250 rows, not in time order): session_id (whole number), user_code (five-digit code with leading zeros), started_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS; no empty cells), pages_viewed (whole number; about 3% empty), device (desktop, mobile or tablet; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent).

task_text: Put the sessions in time order of started_at and compute the gap in seconds between each session start and the previous one. `result` should be the median gap in seconds (a float).
intended_computation: Parse started_at, sort ascending, take the differences between consecutive starts in seconds (249 gaps) and return their median as a float.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x the integer cast of parsed timestamps is in a coarser unit, so dividing by 1e9 gives gaps 1000 times too small

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
